meta.caveat: Deliberately conservative. These are films with a worksheet, not instruction, so nothing is rated strong. 'Partial' means a worksheet question asks students to think about the idea; 'related' means the film shows it but no question asks about it. Mapped from each worksheet's Part 2 questions and the CASEL labels in each film's teacher notes; students' answers were not checked. Frameworks: CASEL (all films), AP CSP, California CS, CSTA 2026 and CA CTE (the computing films), ISTE and UNESCO MIL (Ron's Gone Wrong only), and three Common Core speaking and listening codes (all films, related only). The SEL-only films (Inside Out, Inside Out 2, Totoro, Coraline, Up, Nausicaa, Wreck-It Ralph, Turning Red) have no CS codes except Wreck-It Ralph's one related note on bugs.

alignment_log.scope: First pass: all 15 films against casel, plus apcsp 5.6 for Ron's Gone Wrong
alignment_log.note: Read each worksheet's Part 2 questions and matched them to this repo's CASEL catalog. No strong entries on purpose. Left out: CDE T-SEL, Common Core speaking and writing (the worksheets are writing prompts, but writing is not what the films are for), and the CS frameworks other than the one code above.

alignment_log.scope: Second pass: apcsp, castandards, csta2026, ca-ict-anchor, iste-digital-citizen, unesco-mil and ccss-ela added after the first pass looked only at CASEL
alignment_log.note: Read the catalog paraphrases for each framework and matched them to the worksheets' Part 2 questions. Ron's Gone Wrong apcsp 5.6 raised from related to partial because a worksheet question asks about data collection. Left out: unesco-ai-cfs and aasl-engage (nothing in the worksheets asks about AI as a tool students use), CSTA 2017 (legacy), Common Core writing codes (the worksheets are writing prompts but the films are not there to teach writing), and csta2026 high school codes.

alignment_log.scope: Third pass: Sneakers, WarGames and The AI Doc against casel, apcsp, castandards, csta2026, ca-ict-anchor, unesco-ai-cfs, unesco-mil and ccss-ela
alignment_log.note: Mapped from the new worksheets' Part 2 questions and the catalog paraphrases. The AI Doc's Part 1 questions 4 and 5 have no confirmed answers, so no standards claim rests on them.

alignment_log.scope: Fourth pass: the Veritasium ASML video against casel, ca-ict-anchor, csta2026, castandards and ccss-ela
alignment_log.note: It is a hardware video, so the computing fits are few and mostly related. No programming or networking codes were claimed.
